description:
More often than not, your procrastination is caused by expectations that don’t align with your emotions—

—“I should be doing this”, “I need to achieve this much”—

—and the discomfort drives avoidance.

There’s no right way! It’s a matter of what helps you move in the direction you’re interested in…

…if it ain’t helping, might as well try something else!

So be free! Free from needless expectations. Try shit and see what works ✨

You’ll get there, and the path won’t follow your expectations at all 🥳

AND, if you want a hand with any of this, comment ‘root’—

I can help! It’s my job ✌️
transcript: 73 things I wish I had learned before I turned 25. Shut the fuck up. Who's fucking timing? Stan Lee, Vera Wang, Martha Stewart didn't make it until they were 40. Stop making it about time. You don't have to be anywhere else. You don't have to be anyone else. You don't need five productivity tips or the 700 habits of highly successful people. Fuck. You're great. You're growing. You're more than enough. I'm going that way if you want to come.
